candidate.scope: Mirage tender implementation, projections, gates, tests and claims; unrelated forecasting/MCP additions are excluded

independent_subreview.scope: Read-only exact-candidate receipt audit and controlled negative fixtures

decision.physical_observation: Eight target-specific test executions observed on nas-1 at recorded times; no persistent-service claim

clock.scope: Host clock sample only; fleet synchronization unverified. UTC, boot-monotonic deadlines, and Lamport counters are distinct.

findings.title: Presence-only admission gate
findings.observed: Both gate and selfcheck returned 0 with eight zero-byte placeholder files and no execution receipts.
findings.required_fix: Verify strict candidate-, artifact-, host/boot- and invocation-bound execution receipts; missing or invalid evidence must return nonzero.

findings.title: Hard-coded live verification
findings.observed: default_verified_probe always reports nas-1, 2026-09-07T12:21:04Z and three passing executions. Wisp serializes it directly; live HTTP response matched these constants.
findings.required_fix: Project fresh supervised observations; expose absent, stale, failed and unknown states across API and cockpit.

findings.title: Unquoted shell interpolation
findings.observed: Existing image below a PWD directory containing '; true #' turned /usr/bin/false into exit_code=0, passed=true.
findings.required_fix: Use argument-vector process creation, trusted executable selection and confined artifact paths; no shell string construction.

findings.title: Unbounded tender processes
findings.observed: sleep-5 fixture produced no receipt before an external 1-second timeout killed its process group. input_line has no line-byte limit; close_process_in has no deadline.
findings.required_fix: OTP-owned monotonic deadlines, bounded stdout/stderr, concurrent draining, process-group termination and reaping; receipt must represent timeout distinctly.

findings.title: Exit-only receipt accepts failed or absent guest behavior
findings.observed: /usr/bin/true plus an empty image was accepted with empty output. Real virtio hello without expected cmdline and real stack-corruption abort both exited 83.
findings.required_fix: Require pinned executable/image identity and per-test output predicates; distinguish successful hello from expected SSP abort. Bind full bounded output digest and profile, not exit code alone.

findings.title: Aggregate excludes virtio
findings.observed: Aggregate matches only HVT and SPT receipts; virtio result does not participate.
findings.required_fix: Return named per-target states; any all-target claim must require all specified targets and every required check.

findings.title: Tests affirm labels without checking tender behavior
findings.observed: Exact test returned 0 with PATH=/nonexistent and overall_readiness=hypervisor_unavailable; Gleam test asserts the static PASS report.
findings.required_fix: Add absence, invalid image/output, wrong backend, timeout, mutation, stale receipt, artifact replacement, parser and partial-aggregate negative tests.

findings.title: Live OTP version contradicts the hard requirement
findings.observed: Port 4100 listener PID3117652 executable /usr/lib/erlang/erts-15.2.7.4/bin/beam.smp belongs to host OTP27. Page displays OTP29. Isolated tests used OTP29.0.6.
findings.required_fix: Publish actual runtime identity and perform separately authorized tested OTP29 deployment with current runtime ownership; build success alone does not establish the running version.
findings.runtime_locator: nas-1 TCP 4100 listener PID 3117652 at review time

findings.title: Inherited KVM probe invents API version
findings.observed: Probe assigns Some 12 after open(O_RDWR), with no ioctl. Independent strace did observe actual KVM_GET_API_VERSION=12 on this host.
findings.required_fix: Report the actual ioctl receipt or unknown; do not convert device accessibility into API verification.

checks.build_warning_claim: CONTRADICTED: isolated OTP29 builds emit existing deprecation/empty-module warnings

endpoint_observations.hypervisor_response: Static observation dated 2026-09-07T12:21:04Z; not live validation

source_provenance.package_metadata: Installed OPAM record names Solo5 0.12.1 and a release SHA512; this review did not independently rebuild or validate the entire source snapshot.

coordination.agy_response_scope: Agrees with blocking findings, preserves b64532f3 and will prepare fixes separately; not deployment/admission authority

recommended_features.name: Bounded tender conformance and receipt service
recommended_features.owner: Gleam/OTP lifecycle and fencing; Hermes OCaml receipt schema/oracle
recommended_features.acceptance: Fresh candidate/image/executable/host/boot/run-bound receipts; strict per-test outcomes; bounded argv execution; negative-control tests; all projections use the same validated observation.

recommended_features.name: Measured tender metrics and first actual Mirage leaf
recommended_features.owner: Hermes measurement analysis, Gleam control; optional OCaml Mirage exporter
recommended_features.acceptance: Per-profile cold-start/ready latency distributions, CPU/RSS/sample count and uncertainty; separate projections from measurements; actual target build/boot/network and restart tests before admission.

references.title: Solo5 0.12.1 virtio exit implementation
references.interpretation: Writes 41 to isa-debug-exit, yielding 83 regardless of guest exit status.

references.title: Solo5 0.12.1 hello test
references.interpretation: Expected command line controls SUCCESS output; function still returns success for other arguments.

references.title: Solo5 architecture
references.interpretation: HVT and SPT are tenders; virtio is a target launched here through a QEMU wrapper.
